glosses: To forgive; to pardon; to overlook.

examples.text: I excused him his transgressions.

glosses: To allow to leave, or release from any obligation.

examples.text: May I be excused from the table?
I excused myself from the proceedings to think over what I'd heard.

glosses: To provide an excuse for; to justify.

examples.text: You know he shouldn't have done it, so don't try to excuse his behavior!

glosses: To relieve of an imputation by apology or defense; to make apology for as not seriously evil; to ask pardon or indulgence for.

examples.text: Agayne / thynke ye that we excuſe oure ſelves? we ſpeake in Chriſt in the ſight of God. But we do all thyngꝭ dearly beloved for youre edifyinge.

glosses: An explanation designed to avoid or alleviate guilt or negative judgment; a plea offered in extenuation of a fault.

examples.text: Tell me why you were late – and I don't want to hear any excuses!
I had to make an excuse for being late to the meeting.
And they all atonce begane to make excuſe. The fyrſt ſayd vnto him: I have bought a ferme / and I muſt nedes goo and ſe it / I praye the have me excuſed.

glosses: A defense to a criminal or civil charge wherein the accused party admits to doing acts for which legal consequences would normally be appropriate, but asserts that special circumstances relieve that party of culpability for having done those acts.
An example of something that is substandard or of inferior quality.

examples.text: That thing is a poor excuse for a gingerbread man. Hasn't anyone taught you how to bake?

glosses: Disculper dans une certaine mesure, présenter une personne ou une action comme moins coupable qu’elle ne semble.

examples.text: Il l’a excusé auprès de moi. Il s’efforçait vainement de l’excuser. On doit excuser les fautes de la jeunesse.
Il faut excuser ce léger oubli. Excusez l’état où je suis. Vous m’excuserez si je ne vous accompagne pas plus loin.
Rien ne peut faire excuser une telle conduite. et par extension: Rien n’excuse une telle conduite.

glosses: Reconnaître une personne ou une action comme moins coupable qu’on ne l’avait cru, faire grâce.

examples.text: Après l’avoir entendu, on ne peut s’empêcher de l’excuser.

glosses: Autoriser quelqu’un à ne pas faire une chose, dispenser d'une obligation.

examples.text: Il m’a invité à souper, je l’ai prié de m’en excuser.
